# orgviz

> Organisation charts drawn from YAML files. Read charts through the Connect RPC API and OpenAPI spec, or create and edit them through the MCP server.

orgviz exposes machine-readable integration endpoints on the same base URL as the web application.

The Connect RPC API is read-only and needs no authentication. The MCP server can create and change charts and upload avatar images. It is off unless the administrator sets `mcp.enabled: true` in config.yaml, and it has no authentication, so it is meant for trusted networks. Each MCP tool result includes the chart's browser URL so a person can review the chart.

## API

- [Connect RPC API](/api): orgviz Connect/gRPC-over-HTTP API for listing, reading and previewing charts (prefix `/api`)
- [OpenAPI spec](/openapi): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON description of the Connect RPC API

## MCP

- [MCP server](/mcp): Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP) endpoint for AI assistants and agents to create charts, edit their YAML and theme, export a PNG, save shared themes, and upload avatars

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jamesread/orgviz): Source code, issues, and releases
